title: 第3264章 大战枕星府天骄第3263章 一剑斩灭
lines: “这种层面的战斗，不是我们可以参与的！”
年朝禹还是比较担心萧诺的。
林今昭被萧诺打崩了道心，一直耿耿于怀，恨不得萧诺多栽点跟头。
但年朝禹却念及萧诺的恩情。
可是，担心归担心，以青苍宗几人的能耐，的确做不了什么事情。
昆墟兽山的昔寻悦也是无奈摇头：“太冲动了……”
如果刚才萧诺选择退让，也不至于激怒枕星府的人。
可萧诺一剑把枕星府的一位上阶神帝给杀了，柴宇彻底被激怒。
“轰隆隆！”
说时迟，那时快。
地阶神帝中期的强大神力暴涌如潮，直冲云霄。
在柴宇的掌控下，浩瀚神力凝聚在一起，当即化作一道接一道可怕的银色铁链。
这些银色铁链犹如巨蟒一般冲向萧诺。
每一道铁链都蕴含着非常可怕威能。
而且，每一道铁链都无比凝实，且燃烧着灼热的星火。
萧诺扬手一挥，手中的杀之道转化为盾形态。
盾形态的杀之道迅速放大，犹如一座门墙。
诸多铁链撞击在上面，产生剧烈的能量波动。
广场上的众人皆是被这股余波震飞出去。
“快闪！”
“快躲开！”
“别离的太近！”
众人纷纷离开自己的位置。
就连云荒宗的姬寒山等人也是往后拉开身位。
“姬师兄，我们怎么办？”一名云荒宗弟子问道。
姬寒山微微一笑：“不急，先看戏！”
强大的铁链不断撞击在了杀之道上面，每一次的碰撞都引起震耳欲聋的轰鸣声。
尽管柴宇攻势凶猛，但萧诺的防御却是坚不可摧。
其他几个枕星府的弟子二话不说，纷纷朝着萧诺杀去。
“大家别跟他讲什么道义，一起上！”
“敢杀我枕星府的人，我要你死无全尸！”
看着杀气腾腾的几人，萧诺的脸上泛起一抹蔑笑。
萧诺眸中一闪寒光，下一秒钟，一股极其可怕的气势暴涌出来。
“以身为阵·极霜大阵·开阵！”
“轰隆！”
content_en:
"A battle at this level is not something we can participate in!"
Nian Chaoyu was still worried about Xiao Nuo.
Lin Jinzhao was heartbroken by Xiao Nuo, and he has always been resentful about it, wishing that Xiao Nuo would suffer more.
But Nian Chaoyu missed Xiao Nuo's kindness.
However, worries are worries. With the abilities of the Qing Cang Sect members, they really can't do much.
Xi Xunyue from Kunxu Beast Mountain also shook his head helplessly: "I'm so impulsive..."
If Xiao Nuo had chosen to give in just now, it would not have angered the people in Zhenxing Mansion.
But Xiao Nuo killed a high-ranking god emperor in Zhenxing Mansion with one sword, and Chai Yu was completely angered.
"Boom!"
It's too late, but it's soon.
The powerful divine power of the Earth-level God Emperor in the middle stage surged like a tide, soaring straight into the sky.
Under Chai Yu's control, the vast divine power gathered together and immediately turned into terrifying silver chains one after another.
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
These silver iron chains rushed towards Xiao Nuo like giant pythons.
Every iron chain contains very terrifying power.
Moreover, every iron chain is extremely solid and burning with hot sparks.
Xiao Nuo waved his hand, and the killing method in his hand transformed into a shield form.
The way to kill in the form of a shield quickly enlarged, like a door wall.
Many iron chains hit it, causing violent energy fluctuations.
Everyone in the square was blown away by the aftermath.
"Flash!"
"Get out of the way!"
"Don't get too close!"
"..."
Everyone left their positions one after another.
Even Ji Hanshan and others from the Yunhuang Sect moved back.
"Senior Brother Ji, what should we do?" asked a Yunhuang Sect disciple.
Ji Hanshan smiled slightly: "No rush, let's watch the show first!"
The powerful iron chain continuously hit the killing path, and every collision caused a deafening roar.
Although Chai Yu's attack was fierce, Xiao Nuo's defense was impenetrable.
Several other disciples from Zhenxing Mansion rushed towards Xiao Nuo without saying a word.
"Everyone, don't talk to him about morality, let's go together!"
"Anyone who dares to kill me, Zhenxing Mansion, will die with your body intact!"
"Kill!"
"..."
Looking at the murderous people, a scornful smile appeared on Xiao Nuo's face.
A cold light flashed in Xiao Nuo's eyes, and in the next second, an extremely terrifying aura surged out.
"Use your body to form the Extreme Frost Formation and start the formation!"
"Boom!"
title_en: Chapter 3264: Battle with the Prodigy of Zhenxing Mansion Chapter 3263: Killed with One Sword
